title: Dizzy hired by Calloway
summary: Cab fires Mouse Randolph to hire Dizzy, and Bauza advises him to brief the rhythm section on his chord changes.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Two, three weeks after he come and he say, let's get hold of that guy. So he fire the single trumpet player, Mouse Randolph from St. Louis. He fire him, took on Dizzy in the band. So I say, now, the best thing for you to do to develop what you're doing, you got to get hold of that piano player and the bass player, and you corner. Tell ahead of time what you want them to do harmonically. You know why? Because you play a whole lot of changes they don't use in this band.
So he did that, and the guys -- especially Hinton went crazy about the guy. So he started to develop, develop.
And there he went with this singer. What's the name of this guy that sing Black Magic? What's his name? The guy used to sing Black Magic.
I don't remember. I know the name, Benny.
